answer_1.quote: Open-ended neural text generation aims to generate coherent and diverse text from LLMs, given contextual prefix, and has spawned a wide range of natural language applications, including contextual text completion, story generation, and review generation.

answer_4.quote: Then, we ask 3 evaluators to compare generated continuations from Look-back and the second best baseline SimCTG in two dimensions: 1) fluency: diverse and natural content without repeated words, phrases or sentences; 2) coherence: well-organized and easy to follow; being consistent with the topics presented in the human-written prefix without abrupt topic drifts.
answer_4.guideline: We ask annotators to choose one out of three options: the 1st continuation is better, the 2nd is better, or the two are of the same quality.
